artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow and blue cables in the foreground form a nonsensical, melted mesh. They lack individual strand definition, loop logically, or connect clearly to the devices. They appear as a generated texture rather than physical wires.

The horizontal lines of the window frames and ceiling structure in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence, suggesting geometric instability in the scene generation.

The black surfaces of the speakers are overly uniform and lack the subtle micro-texture, dust, or reflection variations expected from real-world materials, giving them a slightly 'plastic' or rendered look.
